messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need to file a dispute for a charge on my credit card. I stayed at a Marriott hotel but when I got there, they gave me a standard double room instead. I've called the hotel twice and they refuse to help me. I want my money back.

{"reply":"I can help file this dispute. To proceed I need to verify your identity (required to access your account) and collect a few transaction details. Please provide the following: 

1) Verification — please give any TWO of the following exactly as on your account:
   - Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
   - Registered email address
   - Registered phone number (include country code if outside US)
   - Registered home address
   Also please confirm your full name.

2) Transaction details:
   - Transaction date (MM/DD/YYYY)
   - Transaction amount (exact dollar amount)
   - Merchant name as it appears on your statement (you said Marriott — please confirm)
   - Last 4 digits of the card charged
   - When you first noticed the issue (MM/DD/YYYY)
   - Do you have the transaction ID from your statement? If so, please share it.

3) Resolution requested: do you want a full_refund (complete refund) or a reversal_of_charge/other? (If you want full refund, reply “full_refund”.)

4) Card action preference: keep_active or cancel_and_reissue? (Most customers choose keep_active unless they want a replacement card.)

5) You mentioned you called the hotel twice and they refused — I will mark contacted_merchant = true. 

6) Are you willing to let us use this conversation as your written statement if needed? (yes/no)

What I’ll do next once you provide the items above: verify your identity, determine provisional-credit eligibility, and then file the dispute on your behalf. If you’d like me to proceed now, please send the requested verification (two items), your full name, and the transaction details."}
